text: Cross-client: duplicate item names are refused on Android and silently merged on web

Landed. The web gained Android's pre-save duplicate-name check (case-insensitive, excluding the item's own id), with item.duplicateName added to all nine web catalogs matching Android's existing item_msg_duplicate_name by identical English. I resolved a cherry-pick conflict in ItemDialog.test.tsx by keeping both agents' new describe blocks; that file's 38 tests pass.
